column4: Mean absolute error in SOC stock when one soil profile is resampled by one profile shifted by about 40 cm, cropland, 0-30 cm.
column15: TWO assumptions, both consequential. (1) NORMALITY: the source reports mean absolute error, defined in its Eq. 3 as the mean of |SOC_initial - SOC_resampled| across sites. Assuming those paired differences are normal with zero mean, SD = MAE * sqrt(pi/2) = 5.1 * 1.2533 = 6.39 Mg C/ha, and likewise 7.5% -> 9.4%. (2) DIFFERENCE SCALE: 6.39 is the SD of the DIFFERENCE between two locations, not of a single observation. If the two locations are treated as independent draws from the same field, the per-observation relocation SD is 6.39 / sqrt(2) = 4.52 Mg C/ha. Phase 1 must state which of the two it is using; conflating them inflates or deflates MDC by a factor of sqrt(2). Not marked mean_dependent because the source reports both absolute and relative forms directly, so no assumed mean stock was needed.
